completionRules: Every one of the 72 in-scope tools must appear exactly once across the six deterministic waves.
Every audited record must contain every required category.
PASS requires every category to be PASS or justified NOT_APPLICABLE and requires zero open findings.
Audit waves do not repair production behavior; defects are recorded for later repair PRs.
HOLD_REVIEW is reserved for canonical HOLD tools after substantive audit.
An existing PASS in audits/tool-quality-matrix.json is evidence only and does not automatically satisfy this stricter audit.
